admission.justification: Dismissal persistence and UI feedback are a maintained cross-boundary obligation: treating optimistic removal as successful durable acknowledgement silently loses failed clicks. Native action/queue targets and separate bulk/failure/source-defined ASGI assertions establish the bounded contract, not a Curator runtime grade.

applicability: Individual and Clear-all acknowledgement for the operational kinds that survive provider removal and for the two terminal notice kinds.
conditions: Requests use the current item id and a kind the dismissal store admits.
A live cause is refused rather than silently ignored.
Clear all composes per-item requests for dismissible items only.
An unsuccessful reply restores the item and reports that the acknowledgement did not hold.
exclusions: Dismissal of future occurrences of any kind.
Hiding an unacknowledged notice in client state.
statement: A live attention cause cannot be acknowledged away — the backend and the dismissal store's own vocabulary refuse it, beside the operational kinds that do accept acknowledgement — while a terminal notice accepts one acknowledgement for its exact occurrence and a failed write leaves it visible.
